design_type: observational descriptive: repeated national cross-sections of OEWS industry-by-occupation cells
estimand: Employment-weighted within-occupation gap in log real mean annual wage between renewable and nonrenewable private generation establishments, by year (Kitagawa within term on common support), plus technology-, class-, and period-specific versions
identification_strategy: Compositional standardization only: comparisons restricted to the same detailed occupation and estimate year via occupation-by-year standardization and decomposition; no causal identification is claimed; trend contrasts use non-overlapping OEWS estimate panels
journal_method_bar: ERSS: transparent descriptive quantitative analysis with calibrated claims, robustness, and explicit scope conditions

power_or_feasibility_assessment.rationale: Fixed secondary data with 59-77 identifying occupations per year; single-year within gap MDES about 0.04-0.07 log points and 2025-minus-2021 change MDES about 0.07-0.10 log points; smaller changes may be undetectable and H4 may be reported as inconclusive; biomass and geothermal pooled.

causal_gate.outcome: descriptive claim confirmed; fixed effects used for standardization, not identification; see design/causal-gate.md

method_specialist_routing.method_orientation: quantitative observational panel of aggregate industry-by-occupation cells
method_specialist_routing.rationale: Quantitative observational secondary-data analysis of public aggregate tables; standard regression and decomposition route.

assumptions: OEWS cell means are unbiased estimates of establishment-reported pay for the occupation-industry cell
Detailed SOC classification is applied consistently across industries and years
Suppression is unrelated to the within-occupation gap conditional on cell size (checked via coverage and balanced cells)
Non-overlapping May estimates provide distinct panel samples for change contrasts

x.name: renewable
x.operationalization: 1 for hydroelectric, solar, wind, geothermal and biomass generation (NAICS 221111, 221114-221117); 0 for fossil fuel and nuclear generation (221112, 221113)

y.name: ln_real_wage
y.operationalization: natural log of OEWS mean annual wage for the industry-occupation cell deflated to May 2025 dollars with CPI-U May values

w.name: occ_class / technology / year
w.operationalization: SOC-major-based occupational class; six-digit NAICS technology; OEWS estimate year

threats: Unobserved within-occupation composition (tenure, region, establishment size)
Overlapping OEWS panels and ECI wage aging smooth change
Changing publication and suppression of small renewable cells
Private-ownership, in-house-employee scope excludes public utilities and contractors
robustness_plan: R1 balanced industry-occupation cells present in all five years
R4 log real median wage outcome
R5 log real P10 and P90 (descriptive; censoring)
R9 drop cells with mean PRSE > 10
R12 new renewables vs legacy (hydro grouped with fossil and nuclear)
R14 log real hourly mean wage
R15 drop five largest identifying occupations
R16 standard errors clustered by industry x occupation cell
